messages:
sam: :rotating_light: Escalation from Cascade (prod-east). Customer hitting 5xx spike + p99 latency > 4s on dedicated pool. They've requested an ETA for a workaround and an engineering owner. Posting logs in thread.

maya: Assigning ownership for immediate actions. I'll coordinate infra and routing. tagging ravi for SRE help.

ravi: Looking. I can validate pool metrics. Initial guess: autoscaler thrash + fallback to smaller model variant causing cold KV cache. Need a short-term routing fix.

jon: What's current PR for fallback routing? I thought we had a canary - PR #4789 is pending review.

priya: Pinging @jon for review of #4789 (routing fallback + model pin). Can we get approval today? Sam, what's customer tolerance window?

sam: Customer wants mitigation within 3 hours or they'll trigger exec escalation. They can tolerate a temporary latency bump on embeddings.

liam: Oncall here. I can apply a traffic split to route 20% to fallback variant. Need a small config change: route_rules.cascade = {"pct":20, "model":"redwood-4b-quant-v1"}. Who can push?

maya: I'll open a deploy runbook and do the config change, but need PR merged. If review takes too long, we can patch console directly as emergency.

jon: Reviewed #4789, left two tiny comments. I'll update in 15m.

priya: Assigning QA to repro the error path. Steps: 1) run load profile A 2) assert KV cache miss rate > 30% 3) verify fallback route engages. I'll post results.

ops-bot: deploy triggered: run/2245 by maya started.

maya: Quick note: we also need a rollback plan. fallback should be reversible via traffic split back to 0. Documented in runbook.

sam: Thanks. I'll update customer ETA to 2.5 hours and send interim workaround details.

jon: Pushed update to #4789, removed one call to helper, tests pass. Ready for merge.

ravi: After finish, I'll watch p99 and autoscaler logs. Also flagging that a kernel update rolled last night may have impacted memory fragmentation.

liam: Confirming oncall will monitor next 6 hours, alert thresholds lowered.

maya: Merging and kicking canary now. will report status.

ops-bot: deploy succeeded: run/2245 finished — canary at 20% active.

maya: Early metrics: errors down 60%, p99 from 4.2s -> 2.1s on canary. continuing to ramp.

sam: Customer acknowledged. keeping this thread for postmortem notes and SLO risk followups. thanks team :heart:
